recordId.title: recordId
recordId.description: The Id of the current record in context (the Case). Always pass the record ID from context; never ask the rep for it.

workflowStage.title: workflowStage
workflowStage.description: The current workflow stage if known from the case: Intake and triage, Risk assessment, Decision and documentation, Stipulation validation, Final approval review, or Funding release. Leave blank if unknown.
